messages:
leo-sales: Heads-up 0m before call with GnomeBank. They want a short POC (6 weeks) proving EU+APAC residency and strict NO-US-control-plane. Need short-term reserved pricing + BYOK HSM flow.
anya-solutions: Got it. Key asks: 1) data ingress/egress only in EU/APAC, 2) control-plane signalling must not transit US, 3) BYOK with customer HSM hosted in-county/region, 4) list of subprocessors and whether metrics/logs leave region.
sam-eng: Quick tech note: Hosted endpoints exist in eu-west-1 & ap-northeast-1. However billing/aggregated metrics currently touch us-east. For strict "no-US-control-plane" we recommend Dedicated + private control plane (VPC peering). Hosted geo-pin is faster but not fully compliant.
dana-legal: They also want the subprocessor roster + attestation for the two regions and SOC2 evidence for infra + logging vendors. I'll assemble docs.
vik-privacy: BYOK requirements: wrapped key uploaded to regional connector; unwrapping only inside customer's HSM or regional gateway; no plaintext keys persisted. Need a short attestation statement and sequence diagram.
infra-bot: POC ticket created: https://redwood.internal/poc/1801357900  includes network sketch and BYOK checklist.
anya-solutions: Can we give two pricing options: A) Ephemeral Dedicated pool in eu+ap for 6 weeks (month-to-month billing, setup fee) B) Hosted geo-pin with lower cost but non-compliant for strict residency?
sam-eng: Config example to include in proposal: `control_plane: private-managed; endpoints: [eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1]; metric_forwarding: false; routing_fallback: disabled`  warn about availability impact.
dana-legal: Note: For POC we can sign a limited residency addendum. For long-term residency commitments we need negotiated contract language. I'll attach amendment template.
leo-sales: Action items before call: @sam-eng confirm whether metric suppression can be expedited and ETA; @dana-legal attach subproc attestations; @anya-solutions prepare provisional invoice numbers and slide with options; @vik-privacy prepare BYOK sequence diagram.
anya-solutions: If infra ETA is >7 business days, we should lead with Dedicated short-term reserved quote. That buys time and meets compliance.
leo-sales: Thanks team. If we can promise Dedicated private-control-plane POC + BYOK attestation and a one-month invoice option, procurement will likely sign. See you on the call.
